name: Fix a red or stuck PR
description: Fix one pull request that can't merge: failing CI, conflicts with main, or a branch that is far behind. Sent from Git status → Fix. Works on the PR's own branch, never on main.
author: AmberX AXF

inputs.label: What is wrong
inputs.default: CI is red on the PR's head commit

data.brief:
Fix {{repo}} PR #{{pr}} (branch {{branch}}). Problem: {{problem}}.
Failing lines seen by Git status:
{{lines}}
1. git fetch origin; check out {{branch}}; merge origin/main into it (never rebase, never force-push, never push to main).
2. Bookkeeping clashes (_claude/THREADS.md, _claude/memory/STATUS.md, _claude/builds/, tracker.json): keep both sides' lines, regenerate generated files.
3. Find the real cause of each failing check from its log (gh run view --log-failed) and fix it in the smallest change that keeps the PR's intent. Code clashes you can't settle from both sides' intent: stop and report them.
4. Run the failing checks locally where they can run, push the branch, and let CI re-run.
Report what was wrong, what you changed (commits) and anything that still needs a person.
